hook: Nine, forty-five, or nine hundred coins. What should your dog get first?
t1: Tier one, nine coins: Frozen Yogurt Snowballs. Plain unsweetened yogurt only. Two or three are plenty!
t2: Tier two, forty-five coins: the Snowball Ball. A snowball that never melts!
t3: Tier three, nine hundred coins: the Gingerbread Kennel. A look, not a snack. Wood all the way through.
